result_text:
Contributor lists in the landscape report are no longer cut off at `contributorsListLimit`. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests, and I didn't regenerate a landscape report to check the output.

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`:** I removed the `.limit(limit)` from the contributor table. This class builds the all, recent, bots and teams tables, so they all list every contributor now. I also removed the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." note. The sort order is unchanged.
- **`LandscapeReportContributorsTab.java`:** the "contributors sorted by recent commits" bar chart now iterates over all recently active contributors, so it has one bar each.

The `contributorsListLimit` setting and its getter/setter are still in `LandscapeConfiguration`, but nothing uses them for these lists any more.
